_note: Local validator for the backend e2e (scripts/localnet.sh). `usdcMint` null: the local script creates a 6-decimal mint and writes its address here at run time. Program id comes from the IDL. `stellarForwarder`: Circle's CctpForwarder contract on Stellar for this cluster (testnet for devnet/localnet; mainnet CBZL2IH7F6BIDAA3WBNXYKIXSATJGMSW7K5P5MJ6STX5RXN47TZJDF5T), from developers.circle.com/cctp/references/stellar-contracts. `irisUrl`: Circle's attestation API for this cluster (sandbox for devnet/localnet; mainnet https://iris-api.circle.com/v2/messages); the CCTP relayer appends /<source domain>. `relayLookupTable` (set once created by `python -m backend.solana_relay lookup-table`): the relayer's address lookup table. `maxComputeUnitPrice`: the highest priority fee a transaction from the backend or the site pays, micro-lamports per compute unit (the recent fee level, capped here).
